basics.name: Ryan Leite Albuquerque
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer
basics.summary: Senior backend engineer with 26 years building production systems, currently designing Python (Django/Flask) services and JSON:API-conformant REST APIs while owning the CI/CD pipeline end to end. Polyglot by necessity rather than preference — has delivered production systems in Java, C, PHP, Ruby and Python, giving strong instincts for which problems are genuinely language-specific and which are architectural. Earlier career spent defining software configuration management practice at institute scale, including leading a 10-engineer team through a CMMI Level 3 appraisal as a trained SCAMPI evaluator. M.Sc. in Computer Science (Artificial Intelligence).

work.name: CESAR (Centro de Estudos e Sistemas Avançados do Recife)
work.summary: Backend engineering and CI/CD ownership for two concurrent web platforms.
highlights: Build and maintain backend services for two concurrent web platforms in Python (Django and Flask), enforcing production-grade quality through automated formatting, linting and test gates in CI.
Design and implement REST APIs to the JSON:API specification, standardizing response contracts across teams and reducing integration rework between backend and frontend squads.
Own the CI/CD pipeline end to end (Docker, Git/GitFlow, Jenkins), delivering fully automated build, test and deployment cycles.

work.name: CESAR (Centro de Estudos e Sistemas Avançados do Recife)
work.summary: Full-stack development, configuration management and technical leadership across four client projects over nine years.
highlights: Delivered four production web applications using PHP (Yii), Python (Flask/Falcon), Ruby on Rails and JavaScript (Backbone/Marionette, EmberJS, VueJS).
Built and maintained CI/CD environments with Git/GitFlow, TeamCity, Jenkins, Ansible and HashiCorp Vault, enabling secure, repeatable and fully automated deployments.
Led technical direction for Scrum teams, running sprint planning, code review practice and delivery commitments.

work.name: CESAR (Centro de Estudos e Sistemas Avançados do Recife)
work.summary: Full-stack and configuration management engineering across telephony, enterprise web and mobile projects.
highlights: Developed a telephony platform in C on Asterisk, covering call flow logic and integration.
Built an enterprise web and mobile application end to end using Java EE/ME, Android, Apache Struts 2, Apache CXF, Spring, Hibernate, Oracle and Apache Tomcat.
Implemented a complete CI/CD environment (Subversion/Git, Maven, TeamCity, Tomcat) for automated builds and deployments.
Built a Scrum task-board integration for Mantis (PHP) that gave distributed remote teams shared sprint visibility.
Maintained a nationwide production web platform while shipping new features against live traffic.

work.name: CESAR (Centro de Estudos e Sistemas Avançados do Recife)
work.summary: Led the company-wide Software Configuration Management team and drove the organization's CMMI 1.2 Level 3 appraisal.
highlights: Led a 10-engineer Software Configuration Management team through a successful formal CMMI 1.2 Level 3 appraisal, serving as a trained SCAMPI evaluator.
Defined and maintained company-wide SCM processes as SCM lead within the Software Engineering Process Group (SEPG).
Rolled out SCM processes across multiple concurrent projects using Rational ClearCase, ClearDDTS, CVS, Subversion, Mantis, Apache Ant and Luntbuild.
Built automation tooling and Mantis extensions (PHP, Shell) for defect tracking, requirements traceability and code review reporting, later adopted as company-wide standards.

work.name: CESAR (Centro de Estudos e Sistemas Avançados do Recife)
work.summary: SCM process definition and rollout for multi-site mobile device development programs.
highlights: Defined and implemented SCM processes for multi-site mobile device development projects using Rational ClearCase and ClearDDTS, contributing to the organization's CMM Level 2 certification.
Raised client evaluation scores for SCM performance by approximately 20% by automating configuration management activities across roughly twelve projects.

work.name: CESAR (Centro de Estudos e Sistemas Avançados do Recife)
work.summary: Early-stage mobile application development on Java 2 Micro Edition (J2ME).
highlights: Pioneered J2ME application development at CESAR, establishing the institute's first mobile development practice.
Developed 15+ mobile applications, primarily games, for early Java-enabled handsets.
Authored Sea Hunter, awarded Best Application from the Americas at the Asia Java Mobile Challenge.

work.name: CESAR (Centro de Estudos e Sistemas Avançados do Recife)
work.summary: Java development on a standard three-tier architecture.
highlights: Developed a WAP application in J2SE for lottery game management.
Built an e-commerce portal used to validate a team member's M.Sc. dissertation research.

summaries.platform: Software engineer with 25 years of unbroken ownership of build, release and configuration management — spanning five tooling generations from Rational ClearCase to Docker and Jenkins. Led a 10-engineer configuration management team through a formal CMMI 1.2 Level 3 appraisal as a trained SCAMPI evaluator, and authored SCM processes and automation adopted as company-wide standards. Combines that delivery-infrastructure depth with hands-on product engineering across six language ecosystems (Python, Java, C, PHP, Ruby, JavaScript/TypeScript), including a nationwide production platform maintained under live traffic. M.Sc. in Computer Science (Artificial Intelligence), with four peer-reviewed publications at international venues.

Polyglot by necessity rather than preference — has delivered production systems in Java, C, PHP, Ruby and Python, giving strong instincts for which problems are genuinely language-specific and which are architectural. Earlier career spent defining software configuration management practice at institute scale, including leading a 10-engineer team through a CMMI Level 3 appraisal as a trained SCAMPI evaluator. summaries.lead: Engineering leader with 26 years spanning hands-on delivery and organizational process ownership. Comfortable operating where engineering quality is a formal, auditable commitment rather than an aspiration.
